name: Nutri choice Arrowroot
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA) (70 %), SUGAR, REFINED PALM OIL, EDIBLE STARCHES (2.8%) [MAIZE STARCH & ARROWROOT], MILK PRODUCTS (SWEETENED CONDENSED PARTLY SKIMMED MILK & MILK SOLIDS), RAISING AGENTS [503(ii) & 500(ii)], INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, IODISED SALT, EMULSIFIERS [322(i) & 472e], ARTIFICIAL (BUTTERSCOTCH) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, DOUGH CONDITIONER (223), COLOUR (150d) AND IMPROVER [1101(i)]. CONTAINS WHEAT, MILK, SOYA AND SULPHITE.
